revision_roadmap.consensus_summary: All five seats preserve criteria_binding_unavailable, so this field-general roadmap makes no named-venue alignment or submission-readiness claim. All model-executed review seats used one model family; role separation does not remove correlated-error risk. No weakness reaches CONSENSUS-3 or CONSENSUS-4 because silence is not agreement. The passage-locator concern raised by R1 and R2 has one shared remedy and is grouped with both source positions and transported metadata preserved; all other weakness positions remain single-seat findings. Recommendation-level consensus is unavailable because the cards contain no per-seat editorial recommendations.
dissenting_opinions: The package uses SPLIT conservatively at the Schema 6 boundary because the five cards contain no per-seat editorial recommendation fields; this does not convert silence into agreement or invent a substantive disagreement.
No card records an explicit existence, severity, or incompatible-remedy dispute over the twelve source weaknesses; unmentioned concerns remain silence.
